pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal and sub-rounded patches with smooth-to-moderate pixel gradients at the edges. Patch area is heterogeneous, with larger, more elongated geometric shapes on the shoulder and neck region, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented patches on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological web of light tan negative space. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections. The pixel thickness of the corridors remains relatively uniform across the mid-flank, providing clear separation between all observed patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, uniform mane along the upper neck and shoulder ridge, exhibiting a low-amplitude and high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, localized dark vertical marking or indentation is visible on the rump near the base of the tail, contrasting sharply with the surrounding light-colored pelage.
